notes.text: The page defines the image of a decorated surface object under Gamma: components of the complement form S; an oriented component of the marked locus gives a directed edge; sigma exchanges permissible banks; the origin map selects the incident face. The boundary case is explicitly a fixed edge under sigma.

The genus weight is gamma:S to N. The final map is labelled by a corrected r and sends C to Card(R intersection C). The tuple ends in rho; the page therefore preserves the written r/rho discrepancy rather than harmonizing notation.

The live functor claim says it induces an iso on pi_0 and a surjectif on pi_1, calling this a 0-isomorphisme. The grammatical forms un iso, une surjectif, and un 0-isomorphisme are retained from the ink. This run transcribed the assertion; it did not independently prove it.
The final remark states compatibility with an operation of somme directe in the source category and in Gra bipond. Directe is an interlinear insertion, separately underlined.
The manuscript heading is 4). A separate handwritten 47 appears at the lower left. Both were read from the sheet; H’s editorial page numbering was not substituted for them.
The comparison in the S display is a left-pointing arrow with a tilde above it. It was not regularized to an equality or to two opposite arrows.

The page contains overwritten labels whose cancelled glyphs cannot all be reconstructed. Explicit in-place doubts and full independent-audit boxes preserve those sites. No OCR, web source, other page, or TeX compilation was used.

The physical-line count is 29, counting the two written page numbers, the main text/formula baselines, the separate lower row of the genus diagram, and interlinear insertion baselines. It does not count deletion hatching or insertion leaders as text lines.

A local consistency check explains why the boundary membership sign mattered: the definition permits a unique orientation on a boundary component, so the exchange of permissible banks must fix that directed edge. The crop, which has no negating slash, decides C in pi_0(boundary X); this small check supports the written condition without replacing the ink.
